newsitem.title: UK: Cazenove Indian GDR Index barely changed.
newsitem.headline: Cazenove Indian GDR Index barely changed.

text.p: The Cazenove Indian GDR Index was 0.11 points or 0.17 percent lower at 66.41 after the Bombay Stock Exchange 30 share index fell 15.77 points or 0.55 percent, to close at a provisional 2,867.80.
The premium for GDRs over stocks on the local market was 17.93 percent after 17.07 percent on Wednesday.
The Cazenove index is a capitalisation weighted basket of Indian global depositary receipts and measures the change from midday on the previous trading day to midday today.
